description: Figure 6 is a line plot illustrating the proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency, with the y-axis labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in linear scale. The x-axis represents the input length, ranging from 128 to 1024, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 128. Four distinct lines are plotted: a blue line with circle markers representing LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, which starts at approximately 0.20 and rises to about 0.36; an orange line with square markers for Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, starting at approximately 0.15 and rising to about 0.41; a green line with triangle markers for LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, beginning at approximately 0.08 and increasing to about 0.38; and a red line with diamond markers for Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, starting at approximately 0.23 and rising to about 0.51. All lines show an increasing trend as the input length increases from 128 to 1024, with the red line consistently having the highest ratio and the green line the lowest.
